sql: SELECT p.provider_id, p.npi, p.credential, p.specialty, p.accepting_new_patients, p.board_certified, d.department_name, f.name AS facility_name FROM providers p LEFT JOIN departments d ON p.primary_department_id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN facilities f ON d.facility_id = f.facility_id ORDER BY p.specialty, p.provider_id
